Attack_Vector_Mechanics: Attacker manipulates object IDs in API endpoints (/api/v1/users/405/docs) to access unauthorized records without tenant validation
Business_and_Technical_Impact: Mass data exfiltration, account takeover, regulatory fines (GDPR/HIPAA)
Mitigation_Strategies: Centralized data-layer auth checks, scope queries to validated tenant session ID, use UUIDv4, OPA/Cedar ABAC policies
Verification_Controls: Automated DAST fuzzing, multi-tenant isolation unit tests, code reviews

Attack_Vector_Mechanics: Attacker injects SQL syntax or shell metacharacters (' OR 1=1; --, ; cat /etc/passwd) into unparameterized queries or system calls
Business_and_Technical_Impact: Complete database compromise, arbitrary host code execution, total confidentiality and integrity loss
Mitigation_Strategies: Mandatory parameterized queries/prepared statements, ban direct shell execution, use typed ORMs, least-privilege DB users
Verification_Controls: SAST scanning (Semgrep/CodeQL), sqlmap/DAST fuzzing, input validation unit tests

Attack_Vector_Mechanics: Transmission over plain HTTP, weak ciphers (RC4, MD5), hardcoded secrets in code, missing HSTS
Business_and_Technical_Impact: Credential theft via MitM, loss of sensitive PII/PCI-DSS data, session hijacking
Mitigation_Strategies: Enforce TLS 1.3 with PFS, Argon2id/bcrypt for password hashing, HSTS preload, cloud KMS for secret management
Verification_Controls: Automated TLS cipher audits (testssl.sh), pre-commit secret scanners (Gitleaks), periodic crypto reviews

Attack_Vector_Mechanics: Malicious JavaScript injected through unsanitized inputs executed in victim's browser context
Business_and_Technical_Impact: Session hijacking via cookie theft, fake login overlays, client-side credential harvesting, defacement
Mitigation_Strategies: Context-aware output encoding, strict Content-Security-Policy (CSP) with nonces, HttpOnly cookies, auto-escaping frameworks
Verification_Controls: Browser-automated integration tests, SAST AST taint analysis on DOM sinks, CSP violation reporting

Attack_Vector_Mechanics: Application accepts user-supplied URL and makes backend requests to internal networks or cloud metadata (169.254.169.254)
Business_and_Technical_Impact: Exfiltration of cloud IAM credentials, internal service scanning, firewall bypass, internal network pivot
Mitigation_Strategies: Strict URL allowlisting, resolve DNS to verify public IP (non-RFC 1918), disable redirect following, enforce IMDSv2
Verification_Controls: Egress network logging, DAST SSRF payloads with out-of-band callback detection, IP validation unit tests

Attack_Vector_Mechanics: Default credentials, unhardened cloud buckets, stack traces exposed in responses, missing security headers
Business_and_Technical_Impact: System reconnaissance, credential leakage, unauthorized bucket access, clickjacking
Mitigation_Strategies: IaC security baselines, disable directory listing and debug banners, supply all OWASP headers, global error middleware
Verification_Controls: Automated configuration auditing (Trivy/Checkov), HTTP header compliance scanners, CIS benchmark tests

Attack_Vector_Mechanics: Exploitation of known vulnerabilities in open-source libraries or base container images (e.g., Log4Shell, Spring4Shell)
Business_and_Technical_Impact: Remote code execution, supply chain compromise, ransomware infiltration
Mitigation_Strategies: Automated SCA tools, automated dependency patching (Dependabot), continuous SBOM maintenance, strict triage SLAs
Verification_Controls: CI/CD build gates failing on CVSS >= 7.0, daily dependency vulnerability scans, container image signing

Attack_Vector_Mechanics: Credential stuffing, brute-forcing, weak password policies, insecure password reset, session fixation
Business_and_Technical_Impact: Mass account takeover, unauthorized customer impersonation, fraudulent transactions
Mitigation_Strategies: Mandate MFA/WebAuthn, adaptive rate limiting and account lockout, regenerate session ID post-login, HaveIBeenPwned API check
Verification_Controls: Penetration testing of auth state machines, automated brute-force tests, session lifecycle audits

Attack_Vector_Mechanics: Untrusted binary deserialization (pickle, Java ObjectInputStream), accepting unsigned updates or build packages
Business_and_Technical_Impact: Arbitrary remote code execution, deployment pipeline backdooring, rootkit installation
Mitigation_Strategies: Ban untrusted deserialization (use JSON), cryptographically sign artifacts (Sigstore/Cosign), enforce SLSA Level 3, SRI tags
Verification_Controls: SAST scanning for deserialization sinks, cryptographic verification in CD pipelines, SBOM provenance checks

Attack_Vector_Mechanics: Security events not logged, logs lack context, no real-time alerting, log injection vulnerabilities
Business_and_Technical_Impact: Undetected breach persistence (>200 days), failure to investigate incidents, compliance audit failures
Mitigation_Strategies: Structured JSON logging with security taxonomy, centralized write-once SIEM, real-time alert rules, CRLF log sanitization
Verification_Controls: Adversary emulation tests, SIEM ingestion health checks, log forensics readiness drills

Attack_Vector_Mechanics: Unbounded file uploads, missing query pagination limits, unthrottled CPU-intensive endpoints
Business_and_Technical_Impact: Denial of Service (DoS), Denial of Wallet (cloud bill shock), database connection pool exhaustion
Mitigation_Strategies: API gateway rate limiting (Token Bucket), mandatory server-side pagination with caps, file upload limits, async worker queues
Verification_Controls: Load testing (k6/Locust), rate limit threshold fuzzing, CPU/memory profiling under load

Attack_Vector_Mechanics: Overly permissive CORS (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with credentials) or state-changing actions relying only on cookies
Business_and_Technical_Impact: Unauthorized actions executed on victim's behalf, cross-origin sensitive data theft, unauthorized profile edits
Mitigation_Strategies: Enforce SameSite=Strict/Lax cookies, Anti-CSRF Synchronizer Tokens, custom headers on AJAX, strict CORS domain whitelisting
Verification_Controls: Automated CSRF fuzzing, CORS preflight header validation test suites, browser integration test harness
